blocks.text: HANGS Construction Services LLC. Invented procedures for a software demonstration.

Each application is built line by line from the approved schedule of values. The contract sum to date is the original contract plus change orders signed by the owner, and no line may be billed past its scheduled value.
Only change orders signed by the owner are included. Work on an unsigned change order is left out and billed on the next application after the owner signs.

Work completed comes from the project manager's progress by line. The application's percent complete is compared with the job's cost-to-cost percent complete; a difference of more than 10 points is raised with the project manager before the application goes out.

Stored materials are billed only as the contract allows: on site with the delivery ticket; off site only with a bill of sale, a certificate of insurance naming the owner and the owner's written approval. Materials without that support are held for the next application.

Retainage is withheld at the contract rate on work completed and stored to date. A reduction is applied only with the owner's written approval and only as the contract allows. Previous certificates are the total earned less retainage on the last application, including any supplemental application.

Each application carries a conditional waiver for the current payment due, through the period end. An unconditional waiver is given only for a payment actually received, for that payment's amount and through date, never before the money arrives.

The billing entry debits 1200 Accounts Receivable for the current payment due, adjusts 1210 Retainage Receivable by the change in retainage and credits 4100 Contract Revenue for the work and stored materials billed. After the entry, receivables and retainage by job must tie to the application, and billings to date are compared with the WIP schedule's earned revenue as an over or under billing.

The project manager signs the progress, the Controller reviews and signs each application, invoice and waiver, and only then is the package emailed to the owner and the architect. The preparer posts nothing and sends nothing.
